items.reason: Gap 0 describes two in-flight deliveries of the same event both finding the id absent and both running the handler before either inserts it.
Gap 1 says the key is the unsigned X-Event-Id header, so the same signed payment can be reprocessed with a different header.
Gap 2 says a charge.refunded event finds only refund.created in the handlers, so the refund is never recorded.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas; gap 0 concerns queue concurrency in one process.
